_doc: Per-extension enablement, read by the agent-team orchestrator.
Keys are extension names: the directory name for a directory extension
(web_fetch), the file stem for a single-file extension (browser).
orchestrator: true  -> the extension's tools are offered to the orchestrator (default true).
subagent:     true  -> the extension may load in spawned subagents (default true).
A subagent can only call the tools its own .md frontmatter lists under
"tools:" - being enabled here never widens that allowlist, it only makes
An extension omitted here - or this whole file missing - is enabled for both.
